 Dated this the 25th day of August, 2025  JUDGMENT
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there is no threat as on today against the petitioner.
Therefore, this writ petition may be closed without prejudice to the right of the petitioner to move this Court again if an exigency arises.
Recording the above submission, the writ petition is closed.
